 the work permit to start the maintenance procedure and receipt the

Calibration 
 entails comparison and adjustment of the measured pH with that of a known 
 buffer solution. Either one or two buffer solution is used.

Access 
 the programming mode by simultaneously pressing 
 SELECT 
 and
 ENTER.

Proceed with programming until 
 CAL appears, followed by the display 
 of the currently measured sample pH.

Immerse the electrodes into the buffer solution. Wait for the pH reading 
 to stabilize. Using the rollkeys, adjust the display until the indicated pH corresponds to the pH of the buffer solution.

Now the symbol 
 Er1 temporarily appears, followed by 
 the corrected pH value.

Immerse the electrodes into the second buffer solution. Wait for the pH 
 reading to stabilize. Using the rollkeys, adjust the display until the 
 indicated pH corresponds to the pH of the buffer solution.

Now the symbol 
 Er1 
 temporarily appears, followed by the corrected pH 
 value.

Returning the equipment place to the operators after maintenance schedule 
 completed.

Closing the work permit and returning the safety working at the normal 
 position.

Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed 
 on an annually bases or at unit shutdown.
The equipment function is to 
 Sampling System pH Analyzer.
The first draft initiated by eng. Rania Hosny, 
 revised by eng. Sameh Samir, accepted by 
 eng. Hassan El shemy; General Manager of 
 I&C, approved by eng. Ibrahim Al_Shahat 
 Ibrahim; Head Sector of Waledia Power Station, 2 x 300 MW and certified by 
 eng. Gamal Abd Elwahab Inspection and Quality Control Head Sector.
Safety Precautions
At the Normal Operation
Put control station at manual position.
Constant unit load.
Safety helmet, 
 shoes, tools box, avometer, piece of cloth, pail and transparent hose.
Safety helmet, 
 shoes, tools box, avometer, piece of cloth, pail and transparent hose.
Work to be Carried out
Open 
 the work permit to start the maintenance procedure and receipt the 
 equipment place from the operation after work permit finished.
Check 
 the equipment for the dust.
Calibration 
 entails comparison and adjustment of the measured pH with that of a known 
 buffer solution. Either one or two buffer solution is used.
Access 
 the programming mode by simultaneously pressing 
 SELECT 
 and
 ENTER.
Proceed with programming until 
 CAL appears, followed by the display 
 of the currently measured sample pH.
Immerse the electrodes into the buffer solution. Wait for the pH reading 
 to stabilize. Using the rollkeys, adjust the display until the indicated pH corresponds to the pH of the buffer solution.
Confirm with 
 ENTER.
Now the symbol 
 Er1 temporarily appears, followed by 
 the corrected pH value.
2 Point Calibration
Immerse the electrodes into the second buffer solution. Wait for the pH 
 reading to stabilize. Using the rollkeys, adjust the display until the 
 indicated pH corresponds to the pH of the buffer solution.
Confirm with 
 ENTER.
Now the symbol 
 Er1 
 temporarily appears, followed by the corrected pH 
 value.
Returning the equipment place to the operators after maintenance schedule 
 completed.
Closing the work permit and returning the safety working at the normal 
 position.
